entries.title: Static Broad-Mane Heavy-Paw Lion
entries.description: One newly authored complete static stylised mane-bearing big cat. A wide short muzzle and rounded brow join through the neck to a deep shoulder chest and long muscular torso; a thick uneven complete mane swells beneath and beside the head into the front shoulder, while two small rounded ears rise above. Four separately shaped heavy full limbs end in broad rounded integral finite paws, with bent rear hocks. A long narrow curved tail terminates in a genuinely thicker pointed tuft. No copied fox body or extracted griffin torso, costume head or painted stripes. One entire animal model zero scenes. entries.title: Fixed Alternating Paddle and Spine Stair
entries.description: One newly authored complete static alternating-paddle stair appearance. Broad forward foot-shaped surfaces alternate left and right, leaving genuinely deep opposite-side recesses rather than identical full-width rungs. Full under-tread mounting stems join the spine; a broad top mounting landing completes the flight. Two whole continuous inclined side handrails join three complete posts per side. No old ladder mesh is imported and the difference is not tread count or ladder height: the alternating broad-half/notched-half footprint and single central spine form the whole new flight. Three opaque PBR materials, metre Z-up, full horizontal-envelope-centred ground origin. One isolated static architectural prop, no host building or scene. entries.title: Fixed Slotted Front Fence and Low Disc Joiner
entries.description: One newly authored complete static front-fence biscuit-joiner-style exterior. One low broad gear head has a true finite front slot, a fixed retracted blunt horizontal disk and central spindle. Its long rear axial motor grip ends in a cap, cable cue and grounded heel. A separate full tall front face has a matching true slot and a continuous forward-projecting horizontal upper ledge. Two whole side carriages, vertical guides and proud locking knobs attach that fence to the head, while a complete upper auxiliary arch has a true empty grip opening. This whole tall referencing face and ledge ahead of the low enclosed head and rear grip differs from the exposed upright circular saw on a long ground shoe and the vertical dual-post router. All geometry newly authored; no old components imported. Three opaque constant PBR roles, metres Z up, grounded horizontal-envelope-centred origin. One prop zero scenes. Fixed illustrative exterior only: no cutting teeth, workpiece, motor, disk rotation, plunge or fence adjustment, joinery accuracy, electrical capability, manufacture, handling suitability or safety claim.
